propositions: Measurement context (environment, principal, privilege posture, instrument type) must be forced into attested-evidence records as text to enable repo-grounded contradiction detection
An operator-attested criterion lacking measurement provenance is flagged by a deterministic check independent of LLM, mirroring det_operator_attested.py
Evidence from a privileged context (wildcard IAM identity, policy simulator) cannot rule out failures that production-scoped credentials would detect, making such evidence vacuous
Plans asserting unchanged behaviour across configuration swaps without citing the resolution path that consumes that configuration remain invisible to review despite repo-grounded truth
Measurement provenance records must distinguish between instrument types (live-call, simulation, static-analysis) because privilege-equivalent contexts produce structurally different failure modes
